text.insert: The server projects the complete v1 inventory of 21 operator actions from authoritative state. Each projection names its subject, enabled state, blockers, expected transition, and whether confirmation is required; clients display this decision and never manufacture authority.

props.title: Decision (2026-08-12) — two-tier confirmation and an explicit sync publish gate

text.insert: confirmation_required is true exactly when an action is outward-facing or irreversible: it pushes anything upstream, discards work, or is terminal. Sync rests at validated until the operator triggers its confirm-gated publish action.

Publishing a PR batch or sync boundary is outward-facing. Hard-stopping or cancelling work discards it. Cancellation, campaign or session closure, and lease recovery are terminal. Those actions require confirmation; pause, resume, drain, sync start, PR activation, and manual save points are single-click actions gated by blockers. After validation, sync rests at validated; upstream movement adds a staleness blocker and requires re-validation before confirm-gated publication.
